statement: National Works on Paper 2026 runs from 5 September to 22 November 2026 at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery, open during regular gallery hours Tuesday to Sunday, 11am to 4pm, and closed Mondays.
note: Migrated by scripts/migrate-event-claims.mjs (PI-005 Stage 2) from startDate, endDate, startTime, endTime already on next/src/content/events/national-works-on-paper-2026-nwop.json. No editorial judgement was applied and no content record was changed. The 8 October 2026 editorial correction expresses the venue's opening days as a weekly recurrence so closed Mondays are not promoted.
